name: Lifetime Contribution to Tiatr Awards (Commercial)
benefit:
**Award Components:** Shawl, memento, citation, and cash award as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa
**Special Recognition Ceremony:** Honored at a special function organized on 14th December every year on the occasion of the Birth Anniversary of Joao Agostinho Fernandes, 'The Father of Tiatr'
**Annual Limit:** Not more than 5 artistes from the field will be conferred with awards every year
**E
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be not less than 60 years of age. - The applicant must have at least 20 years of contribution in the field of tiatr. - The applicant, if an actor/singer/Stage Manager/Lights provider/Make-up artist/Costume designer/Live Music/Background music provider/organizer/contractor, must have performed in at least 30 tiatrs. - The applicant, if a writer/director, must have written/directed at least 20 tiatrs. - *The age limit of 60 years may be relaxed if the health of the artist is not well. ##### ***Assessment Criteria*** The applicant's excellence as an actor, script writer, director, singer, lyricist, set designer will be considered. The applicant's receipt of any awards in their field will be evaluated. The applicant's innovations on the tiatr stage will be assessed. The applicant's songs (kantaram) recorded on records, cassettes, CDs/DVDs or online will be considered (if singer/musician). The applicant's work in dramas in other languages or films besides tiatr will be evaluated. The applicant's published books of scripts/lyrics will be considered (if script writer or lyricist). ##### ***Post-Selection Conditions*** The applicant must be compulsorily present in person to receive the award.
